feed.subtitle: SAFER Lab is the research arm of SR4A (Safety and Resilience for All) — evidence, tools and training for safer roads, climate-resilient transport, and smart cities that serve everyone.

entry.title: Announcing our first project — a road inventory for Nigeria

link.title: Announcing our first project — a road inventory for Nigeria

entry.content:
SAFER Lab’s first project is the Nigeria Road Inventory Initiative: a comprehensive, georeferenced record of the road network and everything on it, from lane counts and surface condition to crossings, lighting, speed limits and traffic mix.

Nigeria does not currently have this data in any usable form, which means agencies plan without knowing what is out there and researchers cannot model where risk is highest. We are starting with a pilot in a single local government area, building a complete local dataset and the collection methods to go with it, and scaling from there toward national coverage. The data will be published openly.

We are looking for a pilot local government partner, collaborators in road asset data and GIS, and funders. If that is you, get in touch.

entry.title: SAFER Lab launches as the research arm of SR4A

link.title: SAFER Lab launches as the research arm of SR4A

entry.content:
SAFER Lab (Safety Analytics for Equitable & Resilient mobility) is the new research home of SR4A, Safety and Resilience for All. The lab brings together our peer-reviewed work on weather-related crash risk, crash severity modeling and automated-vehicle readiness, and will grow with every conference season.

Our publications are listed on the research page and are pulled automatically from ORCID, and our research themes are laid out under Research Themes. If you would like to collaborate, get in touch.
